allow: PowerShell($out = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'gh_auth_out.txt'; $err = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'gh_auth_err.txt'; Remove-Item -Path $out,$err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $proc = Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\\Program Files\\GitHub CLI\\gh.exe' -ArgumentList 'auth','login','--hostname','github.com','--git-protocol','https','--web' -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err -NoNewWindow -PassThru; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $proc.Id | Out-File "$env:TEMP\\gh_auth_pid.txt"; Write-Output \("PID=" + $proc.Id\); Write-Output '--- stdout ---'; if \(Test-Path $out\) { Get-Content $out } else { Write-Output '\(empty\)' }; Write-Output '--- stderr ---'; if \(Test-Path $err\) { Get-Content $err } else { Write-Output '\(empty\)' })
